note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The final state is drawn exactly as supplied ('linked' or 'pending'); nothing is said about what a photograph proves, about admissibility or about any procedure. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState (plus views).
